subject: Preliminary estimate: Integrating Gas Control into T-Week Planning
context: Quoting a fee range to a client. THIS is what a pricing email looks like in Yancey’s hands — and why the agent never writes one.
author: Yancey Dawson
body:
Hi David,

Here is the preliminary estimate for the Integrating Gas Control into T-Week Planning engagement.

The indicative range is $175K to $200K on a fixed-fee basis. It assumes a 12-to-14-week engagement staffed by a Principal Consultant and one Senior Consultant, working embedded with Gas Control and peer-to-peer with the T-Week process owner. The estimate is preliminary and non-binding; the final fee would be confirmed at scoping.

The attached slide lays out what the estimate covers across the five key deliverables. The number tracks the scope, so you and I can tweak that scope if we need to bring the range up or down.

For next steps, why don't you shop this with Russ, and I will set up some time in about a week or so for us to regroup.

Thanks,

Yancey
